# T4 evals — policy facts render as human answers

Test files live in tests/. Contract assumed by tests: `formatValue(value, unit, kind)` exported from `src/components/covers/format.ts`; `FACT_LABELS` (Record<string,string>) and `labelOf` exported from `src/lib/fact-labels.ts` / format.ts. Import via `@/` alias. If an export name differs, builder adds a re-export; tests do not change.

E1. Duration formatter. Proves {days} no longer hits the fallback.
- File: tests/lib/format-value.test.ts, test "duration object renders days"
- Input/expected: `formatValue({days:30},"days")` === "30 days"; `formatValue({days:1},"days")` === "1 day"; `formatValue({days:0},"days")` does not equal "See the document" and does not contain "[object".
- PASS: `npx vitest run tests/lib/format-value.test.ts -t "duration"` exit 0.

E2. Money object. 
- Test "amountMinor renders rupees" in same file.
- Input/expected: `formatValue({amountMinor:150000000,currency:"INR"},"paise")` === "Rs 15,00,000".
- PASS: test green.

E3. Text object.
- Test "text object renders text".
- Input/expected: `formatValue({text:"abc"},null,"text")` === "abc".
- PASS: test green.

E4. Unknown shape never leaks.
- Test "unknown object shape is Not found".
- Input/expected: `formatValue({foo:1})`, `formatValue({}, null)`, `formatValue({days:"x"})`, `formatValue(null)` each === "Not found"; none contains "{" or "[object" or "See the document".
- PASS: test green.

E5. Banned phrase gone.
- cmd: `grep -rn "See the document" src/ | wc -l`
- PASS: output is 0.

E6. Label spot checks (exact strings from section 6b).
- Test "fact labels exact" in tests/lib/fact-labels.test.ts. Assert FACT_LABELS[key] === label for: sum_insured "Sum insured"; waiting_initial "Initial waiting period"; waiting_ped "Pre-existing disease wait"; pre_hospitalisation_days "Before admission cover"; post_hospitalisation_days "After discharge cover"; seller_name "Sold by"; clause_ayush "AYUSH treatment"; clause_exclusion "Not covered"; premium_total "Premium"; room_rent_limit "Room rent limit"; renewal_date "Next renewal"; free_look_period "Free-look period"; claim_intimation_window "Tell insurer within"; ncb_tier "No-claim bonus tier"; member_count "People covered"; cashless_non_network "Cashless outside network"; portability_allowed "Portability"; icu_limit_text "ICU limit wording".
- PASS: all 18 equal.

E7. Map size and hygiene.
- Test "label map has all contract keys": `Object.keys(FACT_LABELS).length >= 71`; every label is non-empty, contains no digit-run value pattern `/\d{2,}/`, and no label equals its own `labelOf(key)` humanized form unless section 6b says so (skip this last clause; only check non-empty and no underscore).
- PASS: test green; no label contains "_".

E8. Unlisted key fallback.
- Test "unlisted key goes to Other details": build facts with `{zzz_new_key:{days:5}}` through the fact-grouping function used by RealPolicyDetail (or its adapter in real-policy.ts). Expect label === `labelOf("zzz_new_key")` ("zzz new key"), value "5 days", and group name "Other details" (collapsed). Key is not dropped.
- PASS: test green.

E9. unknownKeys collapse.
- Test "unknownKeys one row": render RealPolicyDetail (tests/components/real-policy-detail.test.tsx) with facts.data.unknownKeys of 64 keys. Expect exactly one element with text "Not found in this policy (64)"; its 64 labels are inside a collapsed `<details>` (not open); no "Coming soon" text; with 3 keys text is "(3)"; with 0 keys the row is absent.
- PASS: test green.

E10. Provenance once.
- Test "provenance once per fact": render a fact with provenance "Page 4" via RealPolicyDetail. `container.textContent` match count of the provenance string for that fact === 1.
- PASS: count is 1 for each of the 7 extracted facts.

E11. Junk text filtered.
- Test "pipe junk is not found": `formatValue({text:"Intermediary Name | Code | Phone"},null,"text")` === "Not found"; `formatValue({text:"A | B"},null,"text")` === "A | B" (one pipe kept); `formatValue({text:""},null,"text")` === "Not found".
- PASS: test green.

E12. Seven extracted facts render on detail page.
- Test "7 extracted facts render" in the E9 file: fixture with sum_insured {amountMinor:150000000,currency:"INR"}, waiting_initial {days:30}, waiting_ped {days:730}, pre_hospitalisation_days {days:60}, post_hospitalisation_days {days:90}, seller_name {text:"X"}, clause_ayush {text:"Covered"}. Expect text contains "Sum insured", "Rs 15,00,000", "Initial waiting period", "30 days", "Pre-existing disease wait", "Sold by", "AYUSH treatment"; textContent contains none of: "sum_insured", "waiting_ped", "See the document", "[object". Fact cards remain in the existing grid (query `[class*="fact"]` count >= 7).
- PASS: test green.

E13. No secrets added.
- cmd: `git diff | grep -iE '^\+.*(secret|password|api_key)' | wc -l`
- PASS: output is 0.

E14. verify.
- cmd: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build`
- PASS: exit 0.
